title: Tempelhofer Restaurant Signal
subtitle: Rund um die Gottlieb-Dunkel-Straße
method: Previously discovered Google Maps results reused without duplicate searches; detail candidates reclassified within 3 km, stopping after at least 550 verified food venues with 25+ known reviews. Source searches were centred on the original 2 km area; this is not exhaustive coverage.
bayesian_method: Rating shrunk towards the local review-weighted mean with 100 prior reviews; no removal-count penalty.
